decision_source: explicit owner response to the P7 dependency question
detail: Owner authorized DeepSeek to design and implement the generic F3/replay-ops interfaces that P7 depends on — the class-declared ReplayRun/NodeSpec identity seam and the verified captured-tape (manifest/data) producer/capture interfaces — in dskit/ as a new prerequisite workstream, then use them to close Packet7. This supersedes the prior keep-original-ordering stance for the P8 sequencing only insofar as it now authorizes the F3/replay-ops prerequisite work that unblocks P7; P8 itself remains sequenced behind P7 closure.

required_by_p7: Resolved class-declared ReplayRun identity and NodeSpec contract (identification without a uses-string heuristic).
Members, policy, envelope count/order and composed-tape verification interfaces.
scope.in_scope: The F3 captured-tape capture hierarchy (ReplayTapeDataCapture -> ReplayTapeManifestProducer -> ReplayTapeManifestCapture -> composed tape capability) plus the class-declared ReplayRun consumer identity seam, sufficient to close P7.
non_goals: Full R1-R5 replay transaction machinery (AtomicJournalReplace, AtomicSeriesStateReplace, FrozenReplayPlan.v2, lease/idempotency journal) — not needed for P7 descriptor/binding enforcement.
F1/F2 EventEnvelope causal reordering and the full feed/roster data-capture lane beyond what P7 verification requires.
Real data, replay execution, training, HPO/refit, backtest, paper/live, deployment.

process: ADR-before-code: draft ADR-0127 as a proposal, obtain owner approval, then fresh clean Phase 0 skeptic, then RED/GREEN, two fresh sequential Terra final lenses, then integrate. No implementation before ADR approval.
preserved_open: Packet7 (until this prerequisite + P7 descriptor enforcement close)
F3 (full lane, beyond the captured-tape slice)
